safeguards: Compare trimmed whitespace/case-normalized names only.
Do not merge aliases, transliterations or fuzzy matches.
Compare only complete unambiguous dates.
Preserve ambiguous dates verbatim without choosing a locale.

rules.requirement: Referrer name and contact information are both recorded.
safeguards: Check presence only.
Do not contact the sender or validate contact authenticity.

rules.requirement: Recipient or recipient specialty is recorded.
safeguards: Do not recommend a specialty or perform clinical triage.
Retain the supplied wording.
Do not infer a diagnosis.
Listed, explicitly none, unknown and missing are distinct.
Unknown is recorded but needs clarification; explicit none satisfies presence.
Different dates are not automatic conflicts.
Only directly opposing statements with the same explicit time support a statement_difference.
Do not judge dose appropriateness.
Listed, explicitly none, unknown and missing are distinct.
Unknown is recorded but needs clarification; explicit none satisfies presence.
Absence of text is not absence of allergies.

rules.requirement: An explicitly claimed attachment has an identifiable match in this packet.
safeguards: No attachment claim means not applicable, not a missing test.
Absent or ambiguous matches need manual verification.
Never claim the patient did not undergo an examination.
